components.name: Animated Alert
components.description: Composable feedback with smooth transitions.

components.name: Animated Collapsible
components.description: Expandable content with a smooth reveal.

components.name: Aspect Ratio
components.description: Responsive media with smooth aspect ratio transitions.

components.name: Arc Picker
components.description: Radial text picker with top, bottom, left or right curves, smooth wheel movement and live selection on each scroll step. One persistent bracket frame grows and squeezes around each label. Supports drag momentum, keyboard input, disabled choices, controlled or uncontrolled values, forms and reduced motion.

components.name: Sortable List
components.description: Composable sortable list with group, item, drag handle, content and undo parts, plus a shared state hook. Spring layout, keyboard reordering, accessible position announcements, and controlled or uncontrolled items.

components.name: Image Viewer
components.description: A composable React image viewer for galleries and attachment previews, with animated lightbox variants, custom thumbnails and controls, swipe and keyboard navigation, zoom and pan, accessible focus management, and controlled or uncontrolled selection.

components.name: Date Range Picker
components.description: Composable date range picker with root, trigger, popover content, calendar, header, grid, summary, footer, clear and preset parts, plus a shared state hook. Compact inline and dropdown compositions, direct month and year selection, and full keyboard navigation.

components.name: Card
components.description: Composable card with header, title, description, action, content and footer parts. Outlined or muted surfaces, standard or compact spacing, and an opt-in selectable state with press feedback that composes with Checkbox, Radio and Button.

components.name: Color Picker
components.description: Composable color picker whose trigger chip morphs into the saturation and brightness area. A loupe lifts off each thumb while you drag. Includes hue and opacity sliders, hex, RGB and HSL fields, an eye dropper, presets, full keyboard control, and a controlled or uncontrolled value.

components.name: Animated Color Selector
components.description: Composable color swatches with a spring-gliding selection ring, press feedback, native radio keyboard navigation, and controlled or uncontrolled state.

components.name: Animated Breadcrumb
components.description: Composable breadcrumb navigation with soft path transitions, a hoverable overflow dropdown for long trails, custom separators, and router-link support.

components.name: Tilt Card
components.description: 3D perspective tilt on hover with cursor-tracked glare.

components.name: Button
components.description: Spring-pressed Button plus StatefulButton, MagneticButton, and MetallicButton variants.

components.name: Animated CTA Buttons
components.description: Expressive call-to-action buttons with expanding, hold, and slide interactions.

components.name: Expandable Control
components.description: Click-to-expand button and chip controls that reveal a label or trailing action through spring layout continuity.

components.name: Adaptive Stepper
components.description: Composable numeric stepper whose fixed footprint adapts at its minimum and maximum while the value rolls between steps.

components.name: Marquee
components.description: Infinite horizontal or vertical scroll with pause-on-hover.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Pill, segment or underline tabs with a spring layoutId indicator and optional icons.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Toggle with a spring-driven thumb and press feedback.

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input with label, left/right icons, optional stable error row, error shake and success check draw.

components.name: Select
components.description: Composable select primitives whose panel unfolds out of the trigger on one spring and pulls away into its own pill, plus a Morph variant where the trigger grows into the panel via shared layout.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: Searchable combobox with a morphing portal, grouped filtering, keyboard navigation, and controlled or uncontrolled state.

components.name: Multi Select
components.description: Composable multi-select primitives with searchable options, removable animated tokens, and a morphing collision-aware panel.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Form choice control with a draw-on checkmark, spring press feedback and indeterminate state support.

components.name: Radio Group
components.description: Single-select choice control with a gliding layoutId indicator dot and spring press feedback.

components.name: Bottom Sheet
components.description: Vaul-inspired draggable bottom sheet with snap points, inertia and glass surface.

components.name: Pull to Refresh
components.description: Native-feeling pull-to-refresh container with drag resistance, threshold feedback and async refresh handling.

components.name: Shared Layout Background
components.description: A pill that glides between hovered items via motion's shared layout, with blur enter/exit.

components.name: Bounce Sidebar
components.description: A vertical sidebar whose active dot jumps between destinations on a curved, spring-loaded path.

components.name: Animated Sidebar
components.description: A composable application sidebar with morphing nested navigation that folds into an animated icon rail on desktop and becomes a focus-managed sheet on mobile.

components.name: File Tree
components.description: Composable file and folder primitives with springing branches, a gliding selection, and complete keyboard navigation.

components.name: Preview Rail
components.description: Codex app-inspired navigation rail with compact ticks that form a hover pyramid and reveal a floating destination preview.

components.name: Dock
components.description: macOS-style dock with grouped actions and a gliding active pill.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Composable hover, focus and tap tooltip with a subtle scale and fade, collision-aware side and alignment, an optional arrow, a pointer corridor onto hoverable content, one label at a time, keyboard-only focus reveal and optional cursor tracking.

components.name: Animated Context Menu
components.description: Composable context-menu primitives with a pointer-origin clip morph, a gliding active row, checkbox and radio choices, keyboard navigation, typeahead, and long-press support.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Gooey popover whose panel oozes out of the trigger through an SVG goo filter with a liquid neck that stretches and pinches, then crisp content fades in on top. The Morph variant reveals its full-size panel from the corner nearest the trigger on one synchronized spring clip. Click or hover trigger, controlled or uncontrolled.

components.name: Morphing Modal
components.description: Family-app-style modal. A single panel that morphs its height as you navigate between inner views, with blur cross-fade on content.

components.name: Center Morph Modal
components.description: A composable modal whose full-size surface unfolds from its exact center toward every edge, then folds back the same way with an inset close control.

components.name: Text Animation
components.description: Animated text primitives for spring reveals, chromatic sweeps, shimmer loading states, letter-cascade swaps and character scrambles.

components.name: Number Animation
components.description: Animated number primitives for count-up values, rolling tickers, and fixed-slot digit swaps.

components.name: Animated Badge
components.description: Status badge with animated state icons, pulse feedback and compact size variants.

components.name: Action Swap
components.description: CTA button and slot primitives for swapping text and icons with blur motion.

components.name: Animated Toast Stack
components.description: Stacked toasts with status morphs, swipe dismissal, actions and layout-aware motion.

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Theme toggle button that repaints the whole page through the View Transition API — a rectangle or circle clip-path reveal, or slats that open across the screen like a shutter.

components.name: Bouncy Accordion
components.description: Single-open accordion with weighted spring layout, icon rows and reduced-motion-safe content reveals.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Side panel that slides in from the left or right with a spring, backdrop blur, body scroll lock and esc-to-close.

components.name: Scroll Animation
components.description: Scroll-driven motion: a Lenis smooth-scroll provider and a reading-progress indicator that reads from it.

components.name: Range Slider
components.description: Slider with tick dots and a vertical-bar thumb that bounces as it lands on each step. Drag or keyboard, reduced-motion safe.

components.name: Wheel Picker
components.description: iOS-style picker wheel: a 3D drum on native momentum scroll that snaps to the nearest notch, with wheel, drag and keyboard control. Composes side by side for date and time pickers, reduced-motion safe.

components.name: Table
components.description: Virtualized data table that stays smooth at 10k+ rows, with sortable headers, row selection, column resize and reorder, and a sticky header. Minimal, reduced-motion-safe motion.

components.name: Shader Background
components.description: Canvas shader backgrounds (mesh gradient, grain, warp, waves, voronoi, dot orbit and more) with a single typed variant prop. Reduced-motion freezes animated variants.

components.name: Cylinder Carousel
components.description: A carousel whose items line the inside of a cylinder, receding into the center and growing toward the edges. Drag, scroll or arrow-key to roll it, with a springy glide and snap. Reduced-motion drops the glide.

components.name: Loader
components.description: Loading indicator with seventeen variants: spinner, dots, bars, dot-matrix, dither, morph, comet, scramble, metaballs, newton, helix, percent, and five terminal-style ascii spinners. Scales from one size prop, uses currentColor, and reduced-motion swaps every transform for a calm opacity pulse.

components.name: Treemap
components.description: Proportional tiles that morph with your data, with value and share tooltips.

components.name: Candlestick Chart
components.description: Live OHLC candles with volume, a last-price line, and a crosshair readout.

components.name: Donut Chart
components.description: Rounded share segments with a linked center readout and legend.

components.name: Volume Profile
components.description: Animated volume by price, with point of control and value area highlights.

components.name: Status Bar
components.description: Animated status history with rounded bars and period tooltips.

components.name: Composition Chart
components.description: Stacked bar and area shares with period tooltips and a compact interactive legend.

components.name: Funnel Chart
components.description: Vertical and horizontal funnels with curved stages and animated number tooltips.

components.name: Liquidity Heatmap
components.description: Animated liquidity bands across price and time, with a price trace and depth tooltips.

components.name: Bump Chart
components.description: Animated rankings with curved paths, interactive rank dots, and tooltips.

components.name: Order Book
components.description: Animated order book with bid and ask depth, spread, and volume balance.

components.name: Heat Calendar
components.description: Composable activity calendar with Grid, Legend, and Tooltip parts, controlled range selection, and UTC calendar dates. Supply weekly intensities to visualize activity and total a selected span.

components.name: Returns Calendar
components.description: Composable monthly returns calendar with Grid and Tooltip parts, controlled month or year selections, and compounded totals. Supply your own years and monthly percentages.

components.name: Price Target Fan
components.description: Composable price target chart with Header, Plot, SVG, Axes, History, Targets, Now, Cursor, and Tooltip parts. Supply dated price history and targets; scrub with a pointer or keyboard and customize the active readout.

components.name: Voice Orb
components.description: Breathing liquid voice visualization with flowing highlights, custom pigments and a soft, voice-reactive silhouette. Accepts a normalized level, MotionValue or caller-owned audio analyser, pauses offscreen and supports reduced motion.

components.name: Message Bubble
components.description: A focused conversational surface with visual tones, independent alignment, grouped messages, expandable content, and interactive link or button support.

components.name: Message
components.description: Composable conversation primitives for message rows, grouped bubbles, avatars, metadata, live markers, and a mount-only trailing-edge pop-up for newly sent rows.

components.name: Message Scroller
components.description: A reader-aware conversation viewport that follows streamed output at the live edge and releases control when the reader moves away.

components.name: Prompt Input
components.description: An auto-growing agent composer with prompt actions, model selection, keyboard submission, and animated send and stop states.

components.name: Todo List
components.description: A collapsible agent task plan with morphing status marks, a completion count, compact metadata, and smooth list updates.

components.name: Code Block
components.description: A syntax-highlighted code surface with stable streaming updates, line numbers, focused lines, smooth following, and copy feedback.

components.name: Approval Card
components.description: A human-in-the-loop decision surface for approvals, single or multiple-choice questions, custom responses, and multi-step review flows.

components.name: File Diff
components.description: A syntax-highlighted file change disclosure with progressive rows, line numbers, live change counts, smooth following, and completion collapse.

components.name: Tool Result
components.description: A lightweight execution disclosure for syntax-highlighted terminal output and request responses that collapses into a compact completed state.

components.name: Streaming Response
components.description: A stable response surface with completion actions, rendered content, and an expandable source summary.

components.name: Image Generation
components.description: A stable generated-image surface that moves from queued work through progressive refinement to a completed result without layout shift.

components.name: Tool Approval
components.description: A human-in-the-loop permission card for reviewing tool details, allowing once, remembering access, or denying execution.

components.name: Citations
components.description: Inline citation markers paired with a collapsible, progressively rendered reference collection for grounded agent responses.

components.name: Agent Activity
components.description: One adaptive activity stream for reasoning, searches, tool calls, structured execution traces, or a chronological mix.

components.name: Agent Loading States
components.description: Three thoughtful loading states for AI interfaces: shimmering status text, live agent progress, and cycling reasoning phrases.

components.name: AI Sidebar
components.description: A collapsible AI workspace sidebar for folders, projects, files, and bookmarks with keyboard navigation, optimistic moves, inline rename, and overflow-aware labels.

components.name: Chat App
components.description: A complete agent conversation workspace composing navigation, messages, streaming, planning, approvals, tools, code, diffs, generated media, sources, and prompt input.

components.name: Infinite Masonry
components.description: Responsive virtualized masonry that measures variable-height cards and loads more data as the user nears the end.

components.name: Notification Stack
components.description: Compact notification cards that spring from a stacked summary into a readable list on hover, focus or tap.

components.name: Project Folder
components.description: An interactive project folder that opens its file fan on hover or focus, expands into a focus-managed overlay, then retraces the complete path when closed.

components.name: Card Folder
components.description: A landscape card tucked into a stitched purse pocket that lifts forward as the purse compresses into its bottom seam, with controlled open and card-detail visibility plus a separate overflow action.

components.name: Fixtures
components.description: Animated tournament fixtures in two styles: a knockout bracket that pages through rounds, and a wheel that wraps the same tree around the champion. Both read the same array of rounds, so one dataset draws either.

components.name: Availability Scheduler
components.description: Weekly availability editor where each day springs between available and unavailable, time ranges add and remove with blur-slide motion, times pick from a scrollable dropdown, and a copy menu clones hours to other days.

components.name: Multi-chain Swap
components.description: Cross-chain swap widget with chain + token selectors, morphing views, animated flip and quote.

components.name: Dynamic Island
components.description: iOS-style island pill that morphs between live activity views with bouncy shell resize and blur crossfades.

components.name: Command Palette
components.description: ⌘K palette with fuzzy filter, spring-animated active row and glass surface.

components.name: Morphing Search
components.description: Search field or compact icon that morphs into a glass results surface, whether opened by click or keyboard shortcut.

components.name: Expandable Action Bar
components.description: Compact icon actions that expand into labeled controls on hover or focus with shared layout motion.

components.name: Overflow Actions
components.description: Connected pill rail for primary actions that springs open to reveal extra controls.

components.name: Expandable Tabs
components.description: Icon tab bar where the active tab expands to a labelled pill, with a panel above that morphs height and slides content direction-aware on switch.

components.name: Morphing Tabs
components.description: Reorderable tabs whose selected item grows into a white content surface, with the active shape gliding as tabs move and a shared morph between rooms.

components.name: Swipeable List
components.description: Mobile-style list rows that swipe left or right to reveal contextual action buttons.

components.name: File Upload
components.description: Two file upload patterns: an attachment workspace for mixed files, links, audio and media, plus a progress queue with retry and removal.

components.name: Prediction Market
components.description: Animated market listing cards with outcome CTAs, probabilities and bookmarks, plus a trade ticket with buy/sell modes and rolling amount entry.

components.name: Wallet Card
components.description: Wallet overview card with an account switcher and search that morph open from their triggers, a cascading balance with a live change pill and privacy toggle, copy-address, and Send / Deposit / Swap / Buy actions.

components.name: OTP Input
components.description: One-time-code input with a gliding focus ring, digits that roll in per slot, error shake and a success check draw.

components.name: Sign Up Form
components.description: Composed sign-up form that flags a field only once it is left, then clears the moment it is fixed, with a length-weighted strength meter, password reveal and an animated submit lifecycle.

components.name: Bloom Menu
components.description: A button that morphs open into a menu and blooms iris-out from the center, the grid revealing in every direction with radially staggered items.

components.name: Feedback Widget
components.description: Corner trigger that morphs open into a feedback popup with message entry and animated sending, success and retry states.

components.name: 404 / Not Found
components.description: Animated 404 pages in five styles: glitch scramble, magnetic digits, cursor spotlight, a fanning card stack and a typed terminal.
